title: Ship activation funnel dashboard + sanity checks for lifecycle growth experiments
creator: Allison Grant
description:
Goal
- Provide a single source of truth dashboard for the Hosted API activation funnel to support the Lifecycle Growth Experiments sprint (email v2, console nudges, retargeting).
- Include basic sanity checks to catch event regressions (duplicate emission, missing properties, regional drops) quickly after launches.

Primary funnel definition (v1)
- Signup -> API key created -> First successful request -> First 100k tokens within 7 days
- Supporting metrics: TTFT (time-to-first-token), time-to-first-request, D7 active usage.

Deliverables
1) Activation funnel dashboard (prod) with:
- Funnel stages + conversion rates
- Time-to-stage distributions (median/p75)
- Breakdowns: region, SDK vs REST, language (if available), acquisition channel (UTM), experiment cohort/holdout
- Alert suggestions / guardrail panels: sudden drop in conversion, spike in duplicate events, missing required properties

2) Sanity-check queries / runbook section:
- How to validate numbers after an instrumentation change (dedupe logic, backfills)
- Expected ranges for key ratios (e.g., signup->api_key_created)
- Quick checks by region for missing ingestion

Notes / constraints
- Events must match ENG-10492 taxonomy and properties (dedupe keys, request_id/user_id/org_id, timestamp semantics).
- Must support cohort assignment from feature flags (ENG-10501) to read experiment lift.

Implementation
- Dashboards are shipped via the observability-pack repo so they can be reviewed/rolled out consistently across environments.

Links
- Observability pack PR: sources/github/observability-pack/pr-241-add-activation-funnel-dashboard-panels.json
- Event instrumentation PR (for reference): sources/github/redwood/pr-28431-add-activation-events-for-onboarding-funnel.json
- Duplicate events fix (for reference): sources/github/redwood/pr-28521-fix-duplicate-signup-event-emission.json
comments: 2026-01-13 (Allison Grant): Please treat this as blocking for Week 1/2 readouts. We need a stable funnel view before we ramp experiments. Include a panel that makes duplicate event detection obvious (we got burned by this last quarter).

2026-01-15 (Sergio Costa): Drafted dashboard layout: funnel + time-to-stage + breakdowns. Open question: do we compute 100k tokens from metering table vs event property? I prefer metering for accuracy but it’s laggier. Will propose both: metering as source of truth + event-based “early signal”.

2026-01-16 (Mei Lin): Metering table lag is ~30–90 minutes in most regions, occasionally 3–4 hours during backfill. For sprint readouts that’s OK. For near-real-time alerting use event-based proxy (token_count_delta) and set expectations in the dashboard description.

2026-01-17 (Nadia Rahman): Required properties for funnel joins: user_id, org_id, distinct_id (if present), request_id (for first request), model, region, sdk_name/sdk_version (if SDK). Please add a ‘missing properties’ panel by event_name and region so we can spot partial emits.

2026-01-20 (Sergio Costa): Implemented panels in observability-pack PR-241. Added:
- Funnel conversion (7d window)
- Median/p75 time signup->api_key, api_key->first_request, first_request->100k
- Breakdown filters: region, sdk_name, acquisition_channel, experiment_cohort
- Guardrails: duplicate signup count (same distinct_id within 5m), missing user_id/org_id, region ingestion gaps (events per minute by region)
Requesting review from Allison + Logan.

2026-01-21 (Logan Wright): Review: Looks good. Two tweaks:
1) Make dedupe assumptions explicit in panel descriptions (“event stream is deduped by event_id where available; otherwise using distinct_id+event_name+timestamp bucket”).
2) Add a ‘data freshness’ indicator (latest ingestion timestamp) per region. We’ve had confusion where the dashboard is “down” but it’s just delayed.
2026-01-22 (Sergio Costa): Applied feedback. Added data freshness panel + annotations. Also added a note about metering lag vs events proxy for 100k tokens.

2026-01-24 (Allison Grant): Approved. Once merged, please coordinate rollout to prod + verify against known baseline numbers from last week’s activation report. Also please post a link + quick runbook in #eng-platform and #marketing so Growth knows what to trust.

2026-01-29 (Sergio Costa): PR merged and rolled out. Initial validation shows signup->api_key is ~62% 7d, api_key->first_request ~74% 7d, first_request->100k ~28% 7d (baseline; subject to dedupe fix). Noticed spike in duplicates on signup; likely related to known bug. Linking ENG team to investigate (see redwood PR-28521).

2026-02-04 (Sergio Costa): Post-dedupe-fix validation: signup counts dropped ~9–11% vs prior (consistent with removing duplicates). Funnel rates stabilized; no longer seeing weird >100% segments by region. Added an annotation to dashboard marking the dedupe fix date/time for time-series interpretation.

2026-02-06 (Sergio Costa): Marking Done. Dashboard is being used for weekly sprint readouts. Runbook panel includes queries and expected ranges; alerts are configured as suggestions only (no paging) for now.
